description: Call this when a user asks whether SpiceFactory has worked in their industry or under their regulator. Returns healthcare and medtech, mobility, IoT, and logistics, with what was built in each and case-study URLs, plus the compliance work done with partners (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, FDA documentation for a client's submission). Public, no auth.
